about: The AI pack: hand-curated items in four categories. ai_timeline: events at month precision (`month`, YYYY-MM; the exact day and the source in `note`); ai_released: first public release or announcement year; ai_company_founded: founding year; ai_params: published parameter counts only. analysis/items_pipeline/wikidata_pool.py merges them as fact-checked items marked famous. Each value was checked against its source's text (Wikipedia, or the company's own announcement page) on 2026-10-04. `fun`: an optional reveal fact, verbatim from posts/ai-humor.md section 2.

items.name: ELIZA
items.note: Joseph Weizenbaum's chatbot, described in his 1966 paper (written 1964-1966)

items.name: Deep Blue's win over Kasparov
items.note: IBM's Deep Blue won the May 1997 rematch 3.5-2.5 (it had lost the 1996 match)
